items.question: Which celestial bodies and beings are included as objects of remembrance in this contemplative practice?
premises: The preceding context prescribes remembering Hari or reciting a Vaiṣṇava mantra.
This verse lists the sun, fire, moon, planets, sages, luminaries, and stars as a series of entities.
The nominative forms present these entities as identifiable objects within the same ritual or contemplative sequence.
items.inference: The sun, fire, moon, planets, sages, luminaries, and stars are to be included among the objects remembered in the prescribed practice.
uncertainties: The exact syntactic relation to the verb in the preceding verse is implied rather than explicitly stated in this verse.
items.plain_english: One may remember the sun, fire, moon, planets, sages, luminaries, and stars.
